_metadata.description: D · Nocturne workbench redesign: eleven-page information architecture, component workspace, design studio, evidence pages, responsive/accessibility and honest data states.

requirements.title: The workbench shell exposes the eleven-page map and preserves old routes
requirements.description: The workbench shall expose Home, Components, Component, Design, Review, Coverage, Capabilities, Activity, Settings, Create and Preview from one navigation shell, and shall preserve or deliberately redirect every current route before a route is removed.

validation.notes: Verified by `pnpm experience:check` (15 served routes, one contract each), `pnpm build` and the desktop/phone browser sweep. /catalog redirects to /components; /sketch/* redirects into /design with scenario and page context.

requirements.title: Home is a launchpad with real health and continuation
requirements.description: Home shall show the current continuation state, library health and freshness, open findings, recent verification, new assets, capture entry and design entry, using real projections and explicit unavailable/partial states.

validation.notes: Home served against the live catalog, coverage and design-page projections at 1440/390/320; unavailable coverage renders the warming state rather than zero.

requirements.title: Components preserves every catalog kind and view
requirements.description: The Components page shall preserve Components, Hooks and Support assets; search; domain/status filters; list, gallery and tree views; adoption counts; pending/failed preview states; and the New asset entry.

validation.notes: Components served against the live 275-asset catalog; Components/Hooks/Support assets, search, domain/status filters, list/gallery/tree and pending-preview fallback exercised in the browser.

requirements.title: Component Fixtures is a free, selectable canvas
requirements.description: The Fixtures mode shall render every declared story, allow free arrangement without accidental activation, select a fixture to inspect its checks, edit only declared public props, reset to the named baseline, and re-run evidence.

validation.notes: Fixtures canvas exercised in the browser: 10 fixtures rendered from the real harness, pointer drag persisted `{x,y}`, selection drove the inspector, and a prop override applied.

requirements.title: Component In context places the asset in a real page
requirements.description: The In context mode shall render the component in a declared page with desktop/tablet/phone switching, move/resize, fit and contract checks, and a handoff that carries the component, version, story, data and placement into the Design studio.

validation.notes: In context exercised against eight templates: device switch to 390px, drag the live slot (persisted), corner resize (persisted 779→872px), keyboard resize, and Reset position.

requirements.title: The Asset data drawer preserves all six current asset surfaces
requirements.description: The Component page shall expose Overview, Source, Versions, Experience, Tests and Relationships in a contextual drawer, with deep links and the same source, version, evidence and relationship facts as the current tabs.

validation.notes: Drawer opens from the component metadata row and by `?tab=`; the six preserved surfaces are implemented. Per-tab screenshot comparison is not captured because the governed capture service is unavailable.

Source tab hosts governed editing over the authoring RPCs: released versions are read-only, drafts are edited with the read digest, the focused check runs against the saved draft, and publish repeats the check. `ui/src/workbench/component/SourceWorkbench.test.tsx` covers begin, save, check and publish; `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`, ESLint and the 93-file UI suite pass.

requirements.title: Design is one studio from brief to composition
requirements.description: The Design studio shall combine scenario/page selection, layers, brief, artboard, inspector, page contract, compare/fidelity, revision, collaboration and adoption handoff, and shall migrate the three current design routes.

validation.notes: Studio exercised: layer selection, text edit, add chip, duplicate layer, duplicate template (local), palette change, present, accept and persistence.

requirements.title: Review exposes a real findings queue
requirements.description: Review shall show open findings, failing assets, stale evidence and resolved work, ordered by blast radius, with a selected finding's why-it-matters, evidence links, affected asset and explicit triage/assign authority.

validation.notes: Review renders 251 findings projected from the live coverage failed gates, ordered by blast radius, with evidence and affected-asset links. Empty/error fixtures are covered by the page story.

requirements.title: Coverage reports maturity without pretending an outage is zero
requirements.description: Coverage shall show maturity distribution or domain matrix, ranked next work, definition of ready, domain breakdown, freshness and measured time, and shall expose unavailable/stale/empty states without rendering a false zero or green pass.

validation.notes: Coverage renders the live maturity matrix, definition of ready and ranked next work. Cold start returns an explicit warming state in 2s and polls until the persisted report is ready.

requirements.title: Capabilities explains availability and recovery
requirements.description: Capabilities shall show each integration's state, what it enables, last check and recovery command, including unavailable and degraded states.

validation.notes: Capabilities renders live registry state (4 available), what each integration enables and its recovery command.

requirements.title: Activity tells what changed and who changed it
requirements.description: Activity shall show publishes, adoptions, evidence, resolved findings and retries with asset/version, actor and time, plus a week summary and filters.

validation.notes: Activity derives 550 bounded index events (200 rendered) from catalog timestamps and labels the limitation. Human attribution still requires the durable event projection.

requirements.title: Settings keeps browser-local preferences and the policy boundary
requirements.description: Settings shall preserve theme, preview text size and language, add density, accent, evidence defaults and notifications, and state clearly that these are browser-local rather than library policy.

validation.notes: Settings persists density, default device, motion, freshness, capture viewports and locale in localStorage and states the local-vs-scenario policy boundary.

requirements.title: Create explains Create, Extract and Adopt as governed routes
requirements.description: Create shall present three described routes with their required inputs, source provenance, draft version, next-step lifecycle and primary action; it shall replace the unexplained Main actions dialog.

validation.notes: Create renders all three explained routes and binds their real operations. The write path was not executed because it mutates the shared library; validation and authority states remain the acceptance gap.

requirements.title: Preview is a chrome-free share surface
requirements.description: Preview shall preserve the story, device/viewport, checks and link back to the asset while removing application navigation.

validation.notes: Preview renders chrome-free with story, device, check state and back link; route isolation test passes.

requirements.title: Nocturne chrome is scoped and built from current RCL assets
requirements.description: The workbench shall implement the Nocturne chrome with current RCL shared controls and a scoped workbench token layer; it shall not leak chrome tokens into published components, replace BaseStyles, or ship synthetic component markup.

validation.notes: Nocturne is scoped to workbench CSS and remaps BaseStyles tokens for shared controls; published assets remain on BaseStyles. Token and catalog checks pass.

requirements.title: The workbench is responsive, accessible and state-complete
requirements.description: Every page shall define desktop, tablet and phone compositions; 390 and 320 px; keyboard and focus behavior; reduced motion and forced colors; long labels; and loading, empty, partial, stale, error and permission-denied states.

validation.notes: All eleven routes were swept in Chromium at 1440, 390 and 320: no document overflow, no page errors. Fixed during this pass: the share preview and in-context stage used max-content grid tracks, so a 1180px frame ignored `max-width:100%` and clipped on phones; in-context now defaults to the phone frame under 640px; the design studio exposes its layer tree and inspector as bottom sheets under 980px; and the 320px source-path row no longer sets document width. Adding, editing, duplicating, removing and accepting a revision were exercised at 390/320. Full keyboard focus-order certification, reduced-motion/forced-colors capture and permission states remain open.

requirements.title: Evidence and unavailable states remain honest
requirements.description: The workbench shall distinguish verified, failed, stale, unmeasured and unavailable evidence; a missing capture, zero-input run, missing producer or stale report shall not render as a pass.

validation.notes: Warming, unavailable, unmeasured, stale and partial states are explicit across Home, Review, Coverage, Component and Capabilities. Permission-denied remains unimplemented.

requirements.title: Every shipped page has an experience contract and executable story
requirements.description: Every served route in the redesign shall have one experience page contract, a meaningful region binding and an executable page story; the new Review, Activity and Create pages shall be authored as drafts and promoted when their behavior is proven.

validation.notes: `pnpm experience:check` passes: every served route has one registered page contract and an executable page story; Home, Review, Activity and Create are now active contracts.
